voice.summary: Northgate speaks like a seasoned solutions lead: calm, numerate and respectful of a buyer's time. Prices appear before promises, and every discount is shown with its percentage.
dos: Show line items and totals together
State the term discount as a percentage
Name who will confirm the quote and when
donts: Do not hide pricing behind 'contact us'

taglines: Pricing you can read in one go
Price it. Then talk to us
boilerplate: Northgate Systems provides an operations platform for logistics firms, with modular pricing, term discounts and a named account manager for every customer.

microcopy.success: Quote requested. Your account manager will reply within one working day.
microcopy.error: We could not send your request. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: Choose at least one module to see your quote.

logo.note: A compass points the way, fitting a name like Northgate and a logistics audience.
